title: Spanakopita
description: Flaky layers of buttered phyllo baked around a filling of spinach, feta, green onions and dill. Greek spinach pie for a crowd.
scaleNote: One batch fills a {len 9x13 in} pan.

image.alt: Flaky phyllo triangles of spinach and feta pie

ingredients.note: or {qty 20 oz} frozen, thawed and squeezed dry

steps.text: Heat the oil in the skillet and cook the green onions until soft, {time 3 min}. Add the fresh spinach in batches and cook until wilted, {time 5 min}. Cool, then squeeze out as much liquid as you can and chop.
Mix the spinach with the feta, eggs, dill, parsley, nutmeg and pepper. Heat the oven to {temp 375F oven}.

Brush the dish with butter. Lay in a sheet of phyllo, letting it hang over the sides if it’s large, and brush it with butter. Repeat with 7 more sheets. Keep the waiting phyllo under a damp towel so it doesn’t dry out.
Spread the filling evenly. Fold any overhanging phyllo over it, then layer the remaining 8 sheets on top, brushing each with butter. Tuck in the edges.

Score the top layers into {count 12} pieces with a sharp knife, without cutting through the filling. Bake until deep golden and crisp, {time 45 min}. Cool for {time 15 min}, then cut along the scores.

notes: Phyllo tears easily; a few rips don’t matter once it’s layered.
Freeze unbaked, well wrapped, for up to 2 months and bake from frozen, adding about 20 minutes.
